description_en: Query Intelligent Contact Robot call records

name: ListRobotCallDialog

parameters.description_en: Unique call ID. You can invoke the [RobotCall](~~2717996~~) API and check the **Data** field in the response to obtain it.

parameters.description_en: Creation Time. Format: YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss. The time must be precise. You can invoke the [RobotCall](~~2717996~~) API and view the **date** parameter in the **Response Header** of the response to obtain this value.
